rows.behavior: A failed claude plugin command's PluginError names every git fatal: or error: line from claude's stderr, in order, plus claude's last line, joined with '; '.
rows.fails_when: with a stub claude printing HTTPS's 'fatal: unable to access ...: Could not resolve host: github.com' then SSH's access-rights lines, the message lacks 'Could not resolve host' or the SSH line, or puts them out of order

rows.behavior: With no git fatal: or error: lines, the message keeps claude's last line as now; a long stderr is cut to the cap; the message still names the command and ends with the fix line.
rows.fails_when: a single-line failure's message differs from today's, a long stderr makes a message over the cap, or the command or the 'run it by hand' fix is missing

rows.behavior: The integration tier's retry fires on the SSH-fallback path.
rows.fails_when: an integration-marked test whose install fails twice with the SSH-fallback stderr and then passes is reported as failed
uv run pytest or uv run pytest -m integration fails
rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
